subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the cross-surface terminal tool-error contract umbrella, or should maintainers split/route it entirely to the existing placeholder, native-exec-denial, and incomplete-turn issues?
rationale: The current evidence spans several related but not identical runtime paths, and choosing whether to centralize or split that contract is maintainer product/runtime ownership rather than a mechanical code change.

options.title: Keep As Contract Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open until the provider placeholder fixes land and the exec-warning/incomplete-turn terminal contract is chosen and proven across channels.

options.title: Split Into Existing Canonicals
options.body: Route placeholder work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857, native exec denial to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99645, and replay-unsafe incomplete turns to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97324, then close this after linking the split.

options.title: Narrow To Exec Warning Only
options.body: Retitle or scope this issue to the exec-like warning suppression branch and let the broader placeholder cluster close separately.

recommendation.title: Keep As Contract Umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the provider placeholder fixes land and the exec-warning/incomplete-turn terminal contract is chosen and proven across channels.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from likelyOwners for terminal-classifier and product/runtime contract decisions.
